frame.units: metres, viewer world = terrain.glb frame (x east, y up, z = -row*gsd north)
frame.datum_source: measured: mode of (ground elevation - terrain.glb y), 89% of ground vertices within 0.3 m
frame.uv: TEXCOORD_0 into scene texture_file: u = col/(W-1), v = 1-row/(H-1), 4096 grid

method.shadow: h = shadow run along anti-sun / 0.906 (1/tan(el) - lean.shadow_dir); sun az 152.24 el 47.82 (scene.json); plan outline inferred (colour_edge or square)
method.dsm_residual: DSM - median roof > 1.2 m, area >= 3.0 m^2, h = p90

glb: roof_details.glb (mesh 'roof_details': POSITION, NORMAL, TEXCOORD_0; no material)

record.base_y: prism roof y (m); mesh base sunk 0.2 m
record.rgb: median texture colour of its top, sRGB
